what: When the big title comes into view, each letter pops up from 120% below its mask, tilted 6, 9 or 12° (spread sideways .08em more per letter the farther it is from center). It overshoots −6% and −1.2° at the 60% point, then settles in .9s (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). Delay stays within min(38ms×letter count, 360ms), crowding toward the end (total·(1−(1−i/(N−1))²)). Plays once.
note: Words are wrapped as inline-block chunks and spaces are left as they are, so multi-line Korean headings never break mid-word. Uses Web Animations only
